title: Open: sector-run hands the debrief h.beep, which td-tab never supplies, so the debrief's page ticks are silent
context: Found by test/host-contracts.mjs on 2026-10-07. src/fx/sector-run.js builds the debrief with { play: h.sfx, beep: h.beep, ... }; td-tab's createSectorRun literal has no beep member and no beep name in scope. src/fx/sector-debrief.js returns early from its tick when beep is falsy (line 344) and falls back from play to beep elsewhere.
outcome: Behaviour left unchanged (the refactor run changes no behaviour): the debrief's tick sound never plays in the game. The owner decides whether the debrief should tick (supply beep: (f, ms) => sfx.beep(f, ms)) or the member should go. Allow-listed in MISSING in test/host-contracts.mjs. A second structural finding sits beside it: src/fx/laser-station.js passes its whole host on to createLaserArsenal ({ ...host, passEnded }), listed in NESTED.
